name: fintabnet_bench
description: Benchmarks models for extracting and reconstructing structured financial tables from documents (detection, structure recognition, and cell content extraction). It measures both layout/structure accuracy and cell-level content correctness on financial document images. The benchmark is intended for document-understanding and information-extraction systems in the finance domain.
evaluation_method: structure and content metrics (e.g., F1 / IoU for detection; exact_match or cell-level F1 for extracted contents)
general_score_metric: F1 / exact_match (depending on subtask: detection vs. content extraction)
reputation: Publicly available on Hugging Face; used in document-understanding research but not as widely adopted as larger general-purpose benchmarks.
